name: Vékény (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Vékény (a yellow and blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a pole) above the name VÉKÉNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
